fences.rule: Each family here was induced from the hinges of the antinomies there, so a member here presupposes at least one domain there whose hinge it generalizes, and a family with no antinomy behind it has no standing.
fences.case: Audience regeneration presupposes launch-timing's hinge, whether the audience regenerates daily or is a finite set of gatekeepers who remember.

fences.rule: If the case names two opposed poles of sincere advice in one domain with the variable that decides between them, it is there; only the variable's family, recurring across domains with the domain removed, is here.
fences.case: Frugality's hinge, which side of your ledger has the higher derivative, stated with its two poles and its domain.
